parameters.query: WITH k AS (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS key) INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action (action_id, schema_version, action_type, tool_id, tool_version, risk_class, risk_class_source, status, priority, idempotency_key, body) SELECT $2, '1.0.0', 'smoke.test', 'test.record_approved_action', '1.0.0', 'C', 'tool_default', 'planned', 'low', k.key, jsonb_build_object('zweck', 'Smoke-Test Kern-Subworkflows') FROM k RETURNING action_id, idempotency_key

WITH k AS (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS key) INSERT INTO jarvis_visolva.action (action_id, schema_version, action_type, tool_id, tool_version, risk_class, risk_class_source, status, priority, idempotency_key, body) SELECT $2, '1.0.0', 'smoke.test', 'test.record_approved_action', '1.0.0', 'C', 'tool_default', 'planned', 'low', k.key, jsonb_build_object('zweck', 'Smoke-Test Kern-Subworkflows') FROM k RETURNING action_id, idempotency_key

SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('summary_de', summary_de, 'b', body->>'b')), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_privat.action_log WHERE body->>'smoke_run' = $1) AS fach, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('message_safe', message_safe, 'error_class', error_class)), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_ops.tech_event WHERE trace_id = $2 AND context_id = 'privat') AS tech, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('error_id', error_id, 'error_class', error_class)), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_privat.error_event WHERE error_id LIKE $3) AS err, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat.action_lock WHERE action_id = $4) AS locks

SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('summary_de', summary_de, 'b', body->>'b')), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_visolva.action_log WHERE body->>'smoke_run' = $1) AS fach, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('message_safe', message_safe, 'error_class', error_class)), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_ops.tech_event WHERE trace_id = $2 AND context_id = 'arbeitgeber_visolva') AS tech, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('error_id', error_id, 'error_class', error_class)), '[]'::json) FROM jarvis_visolva.error_event WHERE error_id LIKE $3) AS err, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva.action_lock WHERE action_id = $4) AS locks

SELECT json_object_agg(tool_id, status) AS stand FROM jarvis_ops.tool_registry WHERE version = '1.0.0' AND tool_id IN ('casestore_internal.upsert_case', 'docstore_internal.upsert_document', 'tasks_internal.create_task')

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_privat.action (action_id, schema_version, action_type, tool_id, tool_version, risk_class, risk_class_source, status, priority, idempotency_key, body)
  SELECT 'act_smoke_' || $1 || '_p_' || v.k, '1.0.0', 'smoke.tool_release', v.t, '1.0.0', 'A', 'tool_default', 'planned', 'low',
         encode(sha256(convert_to('smk_' || $1 || '_privat_' || v.k, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), jsonb_build_object('zweck', 'Smoke-Test Werkzeugfreigabe 1.0.8')
  FROM (VALUES ('cse', 'casestore_internal.upsert_case'), ('doc', 'docstore_internal.upsert_document'), ('tsk', 'tasks_internal.create_task')) AS v(k, t)
  RETURNING tool_id, action_id, idempotency_key
)
SELECT json_object_agg(tool_id, json_build_object('action_id', action_id, 'idempotency_key', idempotency_key)) AS aktionen FROM ins

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO jarvis_visolva.action (action_id, schema_version, action_type, tool_id, tool_version, risk_class, risk_class_source, status, priority, idempotency_key, body)
  SELECT 'act_smoke_' || $1 || '_v_' || v.k, '1.0.0', 'smoke.tool_release', v.t, '1.0.0', 'A', 'tool_default', 'planned', 'low',
         encode(sha256(convert_to('smk_' || $1 || '_visolva_' || v.k, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), jsonb_build_object('zweck', 'Smoke-Test Werkzeugfreigabe 1.0.8')
  FROM (VALUES ('cse', 'casestore_internal.upsert_case'), ('doc', 'docstore_internal.upsert_document'), ('tsk', 'tasks_internal.create_task')) AS v(k, t)
  RETURNING tool_id, action_id, idempotency_key
)
SELECT json_object_agg(tool_id, json_build_object('action_id', action_id, 'idempotency_key', idempotency_key)) AS aktionen FROM ins

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat."case" WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS faelle,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat.document WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS dokumente,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat.task WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS aufgaben,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat.document d JOIN jarvis_privat."case" c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1 AND c.body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS verknuepft,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(verification_result, n), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT verification_result, count(*)::int AS n FROM jarvis_privat.evidence WHERE action_id LIKE $2 GROUP BY 1) x) AS nachweise,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_privat.action_log WHERE body->>'release_run' = $3) AS fach

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva."case" WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS faelle,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva.document WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS dokumente,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva.task WHERE body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS aufgaben,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva.document d JOIN jarvis_visolva."case" c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1 AND c.body->'trace'->>'trace_id' = $1) AS verknuepft,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(verification_result, n), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT verification_result, count(*)::int AS n FROM jarvis_visolva.evidence WHERE action_id LIKE $2 GROUP BY 1) x) AS nachweise,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM jarvis_visolva.action_log WHERE body->>'release_run' = $3) AS fach
